mapper.select: SELECT l.line_id, l.mapping_id, l.role_cd, l.sort_order, l.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.user_nm), ''), l.user_id) AS user_nm, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.title_nm), ''), '') AS title_nm, l.line_status, l.acted_at FROM eap_doc_line l LEFT JOIN user_mst um ON um.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.mapping_id = #{mappingId} ORDER BY CASE l.role_cd WHEN 'APPROVER' THEN 1 WHEN 'AGREE' THEN 2 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'VIEWER' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END, l.sort_order, l.line_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eap_doc_line ( mapping_id, role_cd, sort_order, user_id, user_nm, title_nm, line_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{mappingId}, #{roleCd}, #{sortOrder}, #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{titleNm}, #{lineStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE eap_doc_line SET line_status = #{lineStatus}, acted_at = NOW() WHERE line_id = #{lineId}
